## BaseEntityController.rollbackPredictedInputs property

Raw input keys that should be sequenced with rollback prediction.

**Signature:**

```typescript
rollbackPredictedInputs?: readonly RollbackPredictableInput[];
```

## Remarks

Player-owned controllers can override this to opt custom keys into the rollback queue without changing the game-facing input API.
